operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns the activation status of a marketplace app for the current site.

An app is reported active only when it is **installed and active** for the authenticated site. The response is always HTTP `200` with a `{ status, msg }` object — including when the app id does not exist, in which case `status` is `false` and `msg` is `App not found`. Use the `status` boolean (not the HTTP code) to branch.

| `status` | `msg` | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `true` | App is active | The app is installed and active for the current site. |
| `false` | App is deactivated | The app exists but is not active for the current site. |
| `false` | App not found | No app matches the given id (or the app is unavailable). |

The `msg` text is localized to the account language.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The marketplace app id (the `id` of the app in the apps catalogue) whose activation status you want to check.

200.description:
Activation status of the app for the current site. Example bodies:

Active:
```json
{ "status": true, "msg": "App is active" }
```
Deactivated:
```json
{ "status": false, "msg": "App is deactivated" }
```
Not found (still HTTP 200):
```json
{ "status": false, "msg": "App not found" }
```

schema.description: The activation status. Always returned with HTTP `200`, including for a not-found app — inspect `status`/`msg` to distinguish the outcomes.

status.description: `true` only when the app is installed and active for the current site; `false` when it is deactivated, or when no app matches the id.

msg.description:
Human-readable, localized status message.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| App is active | Installed and active for the current site. |
| App is deactivated | Exists but not active for the current site. |
| App not found | No app matches the id (or the app is unavailable). |

401.description: Authentication failed. Either `{ "message": "Unauthenticated." }` (no/invalid credentials) or `{ "error": "Not authorized." }` (API key lacks access to this endpoint).

message.description: Returned when no valid token/API key is supplied.

error.description: Returned when an API key is valid but not authorized for this endpoint.
